articles.summary: Beta Technologies unveiled its uncrewed military aircraft, the Alia MV250, at the 2026 Farnborough International Airshow. The autonomous, hybrid-electric VTOL, which evolved from the Alia 250 eVTOL model, is designed for contested logistics and can be configured to carry supplies, sensors, munitions, or wounded soldiers, depending on the mission. In an interview with AIN, Beta defense team member Larry Smith explains how the MV250 flies without a pilot on board, and why the company added a hybrid turbogenerator to its all-electric aircraft family.
articles.title: Beta's eVTOL Goes Hybrid To Fly Farther on Defense Missions - FutureFlight

articles.summary: In one of the stiffest tests yet for hybrid-electric aircraft propulsion technology, GE Aerospace and its partner Beta Technologies flew a converted Saab 340B twin turboprop aircraft at 30,000 feet between the U.S. and the UK. The companies have joined forces to prove the technology for multiple uses on both new and existing commercial and military aircraft.
